s12_f_kema.see: 整幅重画的这一张：两只角又长又细，往上翻卷着顶在发白的天上，像两弯钩子。
s12_f_kema.change: Change only her two horns. Right now they are long thin curling horns that rise high above her hair against the pale sky like two hooks. Make them short, thick at the base and almost straight: each horn starts at a temple and sweeps backward and slightly outward along the skull, lying close to the hair, no longer than her head is wide, and never rising above the outline of her hair. The horn tips do not curl upward. The roots of the horns keep their glowing ember cracks.

s16_f_seti.see: 整幅重画的这一张：画面下方当中偏左那个金发带角的小姑娘看着十四五岁，脸上一道血、胳膊上一处带血的破口。
s16_f_seti.change: Change only the blonde horned girl in the lower centre-left of the crowd, the one being pulled along by the hand. Remove every trace of blood from her: no blood under her eye, no blood on her cheek, no bleeding cut on her arm, and her sleeve is whole. Her face shows only tears and smudges of grey ash. She stays in the same place, in the same pose and the same clothes. No child and no one who looks under eighteen in the picture has any blood or wound.

s17_f_zarn.see: 整幅重画的这一张：画面左边近处碎石上还站着一头带角的骨狼，旁边一面红底白狼头的敌旗，敌人该在墙的那一边。
s17_f_zarn.change: Change only the left edge of the picture near the foreground. Remove the horned bone wolf standing on the broken stone battlement at the left: in its place there is only empty broken stone and drifting smoke. The torn red banner with the white wolf-head emblem at the left becomes a torn banner of plain dark blue-grey cloth with scorched edges and no emblem at all. No wolf, no demon and no enemy banner stands on this side of the wall of armoured machines.

s18_f_timo.see: 头一回改完：脚印连成的光桥只画了一条细带，从左上塔顶斜着伸进天里，白火照样往城墙上落。
s18_f_timo.change: Change only the band of light made of footprints in the sky at the upper left. Right now it is a thin slanted ribbon rising from a tower top. Make it a broad, level bridge of milky-white light made of glowing footprints, lying horizontally above the whole length of the city wall, from the left edge of the picture to beyond the gate, at a height of about ten men above the battlements, as long as the wall itself. The falling white fire piles up on top of this bridge and spills off its two ends. Between the bridge and the battlements the air is clear: no white fire reaches the wall, the gate or the people walking beneath it.

s20_f_heban.see: 头一回改完：骨片上的数字没了，换上去的是整齐的竖道加横斜道，读着像字母。
s20_f_heban.change: Change only the marks on the flat bone shards lying on the ground in the lower part of the picture. Right now the marks are neat groups of parallel strokes with cross strokes that read like letters. Make every shard nearly plain: only a few irregular chips, hairline cracks and shallow gouges of different lengths and directions, never parallel, never grouped in a row, never crossed by another stroke. Nothing on any shard looks like a letter, a numeral or a tally.

s20_f_dorgon.see: 头一回改完：两条小臂外侧的两块烙痕边缘弄毛了，形状还是一个竖条加两边横出去的十字。
s20_f_dorgon.change: Change only the two pale scar marks on the outer side of his forearms. Right now each is a straight bar with two side arms, like a cross. Make each one an irregular rounded blotch of pale, faintly glowing scar tissue with a ragged splashed edge, wider than it is long, with no straight bar and no side arms. Nothing on his arms is cross-shaped or T-shaped.

s19_f_junie.see: 整幅重画的这一张：三叉戟成了两根杆，带叉头的那一根从左下穿过她指向右上、被她双手握着，蛇尾女人手里另有一根没头的黑杆；斗篷两枚圆扣里刻着像十字的星纹。
s19_f_junie.change: Change only the trident and the hands on it. Right now there are two separate poles. Make it ONE black iron trident: its shaft is held at the lower right edge by the two grey-skinned hands, runs in one straight line up and to the left, and enters her body at the bleeding wound on the right side of the picture just below her ribs. The shaft does not continue past her body toward the lower left: remove the piece of pole that now runs from her waist down to the lower left edge. Remove the trident head that now sticks out to the right of her waist. Instead the three prong tips come out behind her back and show small past her side at the upper left of her torso, pointing up and to the left, half hidden by her cloak and hair. Both of her hands grip the one shaft just below the wound, between the wound and the grey hands. The two round clasps of her cloak become plain smooth discs with no engraving.

s17_f_neg.see: 头一回只改一处没改动：举起的胳膊和握骨钩的胳膊还是长在画面右边同一只肩膀上。场面稿改成纯背影、两条胳膊各写死在哪一边，整幅重画。
